Labs","details":"WHY THIS EXISTS. The Investor API is a brokerage account, not a venue: the chain only sees a plain      transfer out, and the matching mint or payout arrives in a later transaction signed by Gyld. Without      a record of what is in transit, a SuperVault's price per share drops the moment cash leaves and jumps      when tokens land, which is a sandwich on every order. `GyldBondYieldSourceOracle` adds these entries      to its valuation and zeroes them once they are older than `maxTransitAge`.ONE LOT PER ORDER (review on SUP-21848). Every record opens a LOT: one transfer, one kind (cash out      or bonds out), one `openedAt`, one open amount. Gyld manages orders per `request_id`, so settles name      the lot they close and can only decrease THAT lot: a partial fill is bounded by its own order, and a      stalled order ages alone. The per-(account, instrument) aggregates `cashOut` / `bondsOut` are the sums      of the open lots and are what the oracle values. An aggregate clock was wrong in both directions: a      strategy with a rolling book never drained its entry and read stale `maxTransitAge` after its first      record, and one slow order made every healthy order behind it look expired.WHO MAY WRITE. `recordCashOut`/`recordBondsOut` are called by the ACCOUNT itself (hooks execute as the      account), so `msg.sender` cannot tell a hook from a direct call. That is accepted: a caller can only      increase its OWN entries, the only consumer of those entries is the valuation of that same account, a      SuperVault strategy can only reach this through root-authorised hooks, the cap bounds the exposure      and the hooks verify the matching transfer in the same atomic batch. Decreases are RECONCILER-only.DESTINATIONS ARE TIMELOCKED. A re-pointed deposit address is the drain vector for every open deposit      leaf, and the hooks cannot commit the address (it is not in calldata), so the first set is immediate      and every change waits `DESTINATION_DELAY` behind a visible proposal.WHAT THIS DOES NOT PROTECT: Gyld's withdrawal address being the strategy (an onboarding fact), the      order price (lives in the API), Gyld's custody and solvency, and which Gyld order a settle really      belongs to (the order never exists on chain; `apiRef` is the audit trail, not a proof).","errors":{"AccessControlBadConfirmation()":[{"details":"The caller of a function is not the expected one. params.admin_: Holds every role at birth; handed to governance and the reconciler by script

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

isLotStale(uint256).details: An unconfigured age reads as stale, so valuation never counts a lot nobody bounded.

isStale(address,address).details: The oldest open lot is the first to age, so this is "does any open lot exceed the age".

returns.code: 0 ok; 301 pair not approved; 302 no holding wallet; 303 age not configured
0 ok; 201 pair not approved; 202 no deposit address; 203 age not configured; 204 stale         lot open; 205 cap exceeded; 206 zero amount

recordBondsOut(address,address,uint256).details: Neither the cap nor staleness applies: an exit must stay possible. No NAV is recorded: the oracle      marks bonds in transit at the live NAV, like wallet bonds.

returns.lotId: The lot to name in the settle that closes it
The lot to name in the settle that closes it

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.apiRef: Gyld's `mint_request_id`, hashed or left-padded, for off-chain reconciliation
params.lotId: The cash lot the order was placed against
The bond lot the redemption was placed against

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

BOND_REGISTRY().notice: The approved-instrument list; pairs and caps are validated against it

DESTINATION_DELAY().notice: Delay on every destination CHANGE after the first set

MAX_TRANSIT_AGE_CEILING().notice: Upper bound on `maxTransitAge`; a year-old lot is not "in transit"

MAX_TRANSIT_FEE_BPS().notice: Ceiling on the expected-fee haircut the oracle applies to in-transit value (10%).

checkBondsOut(address,address).notice: The strict pre-check of `recordBondsOut`, as a view

checkCashOut(address,address,address,uin.notice: The strict pre-check of `recordCashOut`, as a view, so a hook's `build()` fails the same way

depositAddress().notice: Gyld's deposit address for our account (`GET /deposit/address`)

getLot(uint256).notice: One lot by id; `recorded == 0` means the id was never issued

isLotStale(uint256).notice: Whether a lot is still open and older than `maxTransitAge`

isStale(address,address).notice: Whether the account's oldest open lot for the instrument is older than `maxTransitAge`

lotCount().notice: Number of lots ever recorded; ids run from 1 to this value

lotsOf(address,address).notice: Every lot id the account ever opened for the instrument, oldest first, closed ones included

maxCashInTransit(address).notice: Per-instrument cap on OUTSTANDING cash at Gyld, per account; zero disables the instrument

maxTransitAge().notice: Lots older than this make the position stale: valued at zero by the oracle, new deposits blocked

oldestOpenLot(address,address).notice: The oldest still-open lot for the pair; both zero when nothing is open

previewCashOut(address,address,address,u.notice: Non-reverting twin of `checkCashOut` for the OMS. Zero means the record would be accepted.

proposeDestinations(address,address).notice: Propose a destination change; executable after `DESTINATION_DELAY`

recordBondsOut(address,address,uint256).notice: Record bonds sent to the redeem holding wallet as a new lot. `msg.sender` is the account.

recordCashOut(address,address,uint256).notice: Record cash sent to the deposit address as a new lot. `msg.sender` is the account.

setDestinations(address,address).notice: First-time set of both destinations. Immediate, because nothing can be in transit yet.

setMaxCashInTransit(address,uint256).notice: Per-instrument cap on outstanding cash at Gyld. Zero disables new deposits for the instrument.

setMaxTransitAge(uint256).notice: Risk tolerance, immediate. Zero is refused: it would make every record revert.

setTransitFeeBps(address,uint256).notice: Expected fee on in-transit legs for an instrument, in bps. At most `MAX_TRANSIT_FEE_BPS`.

settleCashReturn(uint256,uint256,bytes32.notice: A cancelled deposit's cash was withdrawn back to the account on chain.

settleLoss(uint256,uint256,bytes32).notice: Cash that will never mint (fees, a failed order). Separate and loud on purpose.

settleMint(uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes.notice: A mint request reached `minted`: clear the cash it consumed from its lot.

settleRedemption(uint256,uint256,uint256.notice: A redemption completed and the payout landed on the account.

settleReturn(uint256,uint256,bytes32).notice: A cancelled redemption returned the tokens to the account.

totalCashInTransit(address).notice: Sum of `cashOut` over every account, for `getTVL`

transit(address,address).notice: The account's aggregate position for the instrument, with the age of its oldest open lot

transitFeeBps(address).notice: Expected Gyld fee on an in-transit leg, in bps, netted out of in-transit value by the oracle.
